## Summary

Provide a clear and concise description of the feature or improvement.

## Problem

What problem does this solve? Describe the current limitation, pain point, or missing functionality.

## Proposed solution

Describe how you would like the feature to work.

## Use case

Explain how this feature would be used and who would benefit from it.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative solutions, workarounds, or approaches you have considered.

## Mockups or examples

Attach screenshots, diagrams, links, or examples if applicable.

## Additional information

Add any other context that may help us evaluate the request.
